landing.subtext: Short lessons, fun games and quizzes for little learners. Maths, English, Science and more, in English, Hindi and Marathi.
landing.tried: Nice! There is lots more waiting for you.

sample.explanation: A cow gives us milk. Cows say moo!

landing.subjectsText: Maths, English, Science and more. Every subject is a set of worlds to explore.
landing.learnText: Short, simple lessons. Tap Listen and the lesson is read out to you.
landing.playText: Fun games and questions. Two tries, and a hint if you need one.
landing.winText: Earn stars on every level and finish a world to open the next one.
landing.starsText: Up to 3 stars on every level.
landing.coinsText: You get a coin for every point. Spend them in the shop.
landing.buddyText: Pick an animal friend and dress it up with hats and glasses.
landing.dailyText: Three new questions every day, just for fun.
landing.teachersText: Build lessons, games and quizzes in any subject. Hindi and Marathi are filled in for you, and reports show who needs help.
landing.featureSubjectsText: Make lessons for maths, languages, science, environment and general knowledge.
landing.featureActivitiesText: True or false, match words, sort into groups, unscramble words and maths games.
landing.featureLanguagesText: Write in English. Hindi and Marathi are filled in for you.
landing.featureReportsText: See who needs help, subject by subject.
landing.footer: IGNITE. Learning made fun for little learners.
